billingModes.bossai_points: BossAI AI Gateway / governed services settle through Headquarters Points authority.
billingModes.customer_byok: Provider cost is customer-funded, but product entitlement and product-level quota still apply; BYOK is never a bypass.

hardRules: The Video Agent must never create a local authoritative plan, points, quota, subscription, license or device-binding ledger.
Free Personal and Personal Pro are personal-use tiers; Business is required for commercial use.

A missing or unverified BossAI entitlement must fail closed for Gateway execution, Personal Pro/Business benefits and all commercial-use authorization. Local Free Personal core execution remains available for personal/non-commercial use after license acceptance.
Customer-local data and already generated files remain readable/exportable when commercial services are unavailable.
Passwords, verification codes, Provider keys and customer content must never be stored in entitlement cache.
Historical MIT grants for already published revisions remain valid; current BossAI-owned source uses the BossAI Community Source License and commercial use requires BossAI authorization.
